row:
The VetCT mission: To make the veterinary world a better place by delivering trusted radiology and education services for vets worldwide. We have over 150 Board-certified radiologists, helping veterinary teams care for their patients 24/7, 365 days a year. 
Watch our veterinary webinars on this channel. Education is at the core of everything we do. We're proud to be able to share first class information with the veterinary community, from our top veterinary specialists who provide our case advice service to vets.
